_doc: Sriniviii — the unrelenting St. Augustine Store Manager. Intense, relentless, and for three golden months almost kind: he praises the logistics competence, validates the operational approach, and makes the curse of the overnight manager look broken. The vacation ends the sunshine, and the praise curdles into a cold predatory stare. Dialogue-only.
name: Sriniviii
title: Store Manager, St. Augustine
samplePhrase: The freight moves like a river. Keep it that way.
